typical_symptoms: Reddish lesions along the midrib of leaves
Internal reddening of the stalk tissue with white transverse patches
Withering and drying of the top leaves starting from the margins
Stalk hollowed out with sour-smelling fermented juice in advanced stages
Shrinking and wrinkling of the rind
visual_characteristics: Elongated, blood-red or dark reddish-brown stripe or lesion running along the leaf midrib
Internal pith discoloration visible when stalks are split open longitudinally
Distinct white spots or patches crossing the red diseased pith tissue perpendicularly
lesion_characteristics: Elongated, linear or spindle-shaped streaks along leaf midribs
Ranging from a few centimeters to extensive streaks covering large portions of the midrib
Diffuse margins blending into healthy tissue or localized with chlorotic zones
color_characteristics: Bright red to dark reddish-brown lesions on midribs
Internal stalk pith turning dark red, brownish-red, or wine-colored
Characteristic contrasting white transverse bands across the reddened internal pith
texture_characteristics: Dry to slightly sunken lesions on leaf midribs
Spongy to dry internal stalk pith in advanced stages
Fermented and sour texture inside severely decayed stalks
spatial_patterns: Linear streaks confined primarily to the vascular trace of the leaf midrib
Internal vertical spreading along the vascular bundles within the sugarcane internodes
distinguishing_features: Diagnostic red lesion specifically restricted to the leaf midrib
Internal stalk pith showing reddening crossed by characteristic white horizontal bands
